author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 finally releases this week. The game looms so large that other companies are using it to market their own games, including Devolver Digital.

The publisher has announced that people can enter for a chance to win their upcoming game, Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed, by reposting the message below with a video of themselves deleting their GTA 6 pre-load. Of course, anyone who deletes their pre-load can install it again, though it might take some time given the game is 212GB.
title: Delete GTA 6 For A Chance To Win Another Game

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
One of the most memorable and beloved Christmas movies is 1990's Home Alone, but it almost didn't happen, and the head of GTA 6's parent company played a role in bringing the movie to market.

Strauss Zelnick, the current CEO of Rockstar Games owner Take-Two, was the president and COO of 20th Century Fox at the time--he was among the youngest-ever Hollywood CEOs at the age of 32.

Warner Bros. was originally backing Home Alone and had actually begun production on the movie until budget concerns prompted the studio to pull the plug. "Four days into production, they shut down the picture and canceled it. That never happens," Zelnick told
title: The Head Of GTA 6’s Parent Company Helped Make One Of The Best Christmas Movies Of All Time

author: Khee Hoon Chan
description:
How do you craft a sequel to Genesis Noir, a game that seems so unlike any other? In Feral Cat Den's abstract point-and-click adventure, the entire cosmos has been encapsulated in sleek, monochromatic illustrations, with characters, objects and shapes that swirl and pirouette in the endless, shimmering depth of a midnight sky. 

The game tells a tale about an ill-fated time traveler who, in typical noir fashion, has witnessed the femme fatale get shot by a mysterious other. And as he painstakingly follows the trail of her shooter across every dimension, every scene becomes a puzzle to solve. Plant a light-devouring flower to get to the peak of a mountain. Toss out underground debris to allow a luminous plant to take root, set within a backdrop of a meteor shower. Genesis Noir is a noir tale of panache, and it looks particularly resplendent.
title: This Noir Detective Game’s Vibrance Makes For An Eye-Catching Sequel

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever's dungeons have changed once again, with developer Blizzard's most recent adjustment requiring an emergency hotfix to address players' outcry.

Dungeons, specifically how much experience points players earn from them, have been one of Forever's most debated topics going back to the game's beta. Make them too lucrative, and players will just stay inside dungeons instead of questing out in the world. At the same time, Blizzard doesn't want dungeons to be one-time affairs, with players completing all their quests in a single run and never going back.

Blizzard opened a new front in the dungeon wars on November 13, making a change so that nobody in a dungeon group would receive any experience if enemies were considered "trivial" to to any player in the group. The idea behind this appeared to be an e
title: WoW: Forever’s Dungeons Have Gotten Yet Another Big Change

author: Eddie Makuch
description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19, and it's expected to help boost console sales for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. But the uptick in hardware sales might not be as dramatic as you might think--and there is a good reason why.
title: GTA 6 Should Help Boost PS5 And Xbox Sales, But Their Astronomical Prices Could Hurt

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The name of the new James Bond actor is official: Pattinson. Robert Pattinson. The Batman and Tenet actor has officially been revealed as the new 007, who'll star in an upcoming film directed by Denis Villeneuve (Dune).

"James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honor of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement. "I'm deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn't be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team."
title: Robert Pattinson Might Be James Bond Now, But Final Fantasy 7 Is His First Love

author: Levi Winslow
description:
We all know what's coming: Grand Theft Auto 6. Whether you're ready for it or not, the most anticipated game of the decade is preparing to launch on November 19, and ahead of its release, EA is begging you to please not ditch footballs for guns.

According to Push Square, EA added a "don't delete" pop-up message to Madden NFL 27. The pop-up says there's an update coming to the football simulator on November 17, just before GTA 6 drops.

"Don't delete," the message reads. "[Encrypted Signal] The target is locked. The crew is assembling for a high-stakes run. Await
title: EA Begs You To Not Delete Madden 27 For GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
After years of development, multiple delays, and loads of hype, Rockstar Games is finally releasing Grand Theft Auto 6 on November 19. What took so long?

According to Rockstar publishing executive Jennifer Kolbe, the team at Rockstar "could have made GTA 5.5, and done it faster." However, "Ultimately, that's not what they wanted," she told The Guardian.

Rockstar boss Rob Nelson, meanwhile, said it was important f
title: Rockstar Could Have Released GTA 6 Sooner As GTA 5.5, But “You Have To Take Big Swings”

author: Jade King
description:
Mount Chiliad is nice this time of year. This positive thought comes to mind constantly as I begin my ascent up the iconic mountain at dawn, peering in awe as the fog dissipates and the bright orange sun begins to peer over the horizon. I could have just taken the cable car to the summit, but I want to savour the experience this time around. I want to feel stones in my shoes as I clamber up awkward inclines, I want to bump into fellow hikers and pose for the occasional selfie, and I want to feel a sense of triumph as I gaze out at the Los Santos skyline one final time. 

It’s a view that millions of people around the world have grown familiar with over the past 13 years, and a testament to the scale and sophistication of Rockstar’s masterpiece, which pushed the
title: Fear And Loathing In Los Santos: How It Feels To Leave GTA 5 Behind

author: Callum Self
description:
Crimson Desert, regardless of your opinion on it, has been a truly interesting game to watch post-launch. Pearl Abyss has released countless patches improving the game or adding free content, created an Enhanced Edition—which is a free upgrade—and, in just over six months, has now launched a massive expansion, Charting the Unknown, that’s far bigger than you’d likely expect. So now, with a tasty launch discount to boot, it’s finally my time to leave the game’s opening area.

If I spent this entire article listing all the features that Charting the Unknown promises, you’d probably get tired quite easily. While the premise focuses on exploring the depths of Pywel’s oceans or crossing the seas, as if Pearl Abyss decided to put the entirety of Assassin’s Creed Black Flag into one DLC, there’s even more beneath the surface, with h
title: Crimson Desert’s Charting The Unknown DLC Already Has A Discount, And Maybe I’ll Finally Leave Hernand

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Ahead of the GTA 6 release this week, publisher Take-Two Interactive and 2K Sports have announced an NBA 2K27 crossover with the game. Starting November 27, Vice City will take over the digital basketball courts, and a special-edition NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition will also be released to promote GTA 6.

The $80 digital-only NBA 2K27 Vice City Edition features Miami Heat player Bam Adebayo on the cover, and for that GTA 6 touch, the art also includes the signature Vice City neon glow. This is something of a first for Take-Two Interactive--and possibly, the rest of the industry--as releasing a special edition of a game that promotes another game isn't something that we've seen before. This version also inc
title: NBA 2K27’s GTA 6 Crossover Includes A Whole GTA-Inspired Limited Edition Of The Game

author: Levi Winslow
description:
A drive-by shooting in Southern California ended with no injuries and an arrest after the gunman reportedly opened fire near a business and office campus that houses Xbox subsidiary InXile Entertainment.

According to Aftermath and local affiliate KTLA5, the shooting occurred on November 11 at an office building on the former Marine Corps Air Station in Tustin, California. The police department posted on Facebook that, after uncovering "multiple shell casings in the area," local detectives worked "around the clock" to locate the suspect.

Sergeant Christopher Peterson told Aftermath on November 13 that although the investigation is still ongoing, an
title: Shooting Suspect In Custody After Opening Fire Near Xbox Dev’s Studio

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The second half of November is usually quiet for several reasons when it comes to new game releases–and one other big reason–but Xbox Game Pass subscribers can look forward to several new titles to close off the month.

Microsoft has announced a handful of new additions to the Game Pass library, including a kid-friendly game to kick things off and a sneak peek at some sporty fun for the first week of December. These announcements typically come in two waves, with a sneak peek split between them, so this list isn't complete yet.

As soon as the rest of the lineup is announced, we’ll update this post with a closer look at what you can download and play soon.

The first game on the way is Paw Patrol: Dino World. Ideal for younger members of the family who definitely
title: Xbox Game Pass Gets Even More Games In November

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The "We got X before GTA 6" meme continues as a Grand Theft has been reported at Walt Disney World's Epcot theme park just days before Rockstar's open-world crime game releases, and the meme comes to an end.

There are no further details to go on here, but Grand Theft, known as Grand Larceny in some states, involves stealing something valuable. Epcot and Disney in general has lots of items that would
title: We Got A Grand Theft At Disney World Before GTA 6

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The popular fried chicken chain KFC has announced a frankly absurd GTA 6 promotion: a fake funeral so people have a “legitimate” excuse to take the day off to play Rockstar’s latest.

title: GTA 6 Promo At KFC Is A Fake Funeral So You Can Take The Day Off To Play

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
No one knows yet exactly what the next-gen Xbox console, Project Helix, will be, but most people are convinced it won't be cheap. The ongoing memory shortage has driven current-gen console prices skyward since 2024, with the Xbox Series X rising from $500 in 2020 to $800 in 2026. Project Helix is projected to cost as much as $1,800 at launch, but Microsoft aims to keep the price down when it eventually releases the device.

title: Xbox Is Looking For Smarter Ways To Stop Its Next Console From Costing A Fortune

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
While you might be tempted to take a spin through Grand Theft Auto 6 right now, you might want to hold your horses and watch some gameplay instead. Over on Twitch, the streaming platform is hosting a GTA 6 promotion that can earn you some cool Twitch cosmetics and goodies ahead of your trip to Vice City. Here's a closer look at what you can get, and which streamers you'll have to watch to unlock them.

How to access GTA 6 Twitch drops

Once you're all set up, tune in to any Twitch Drop-enabled livestream during a live Twitch Drops period--November 18-30--and watch for a minimum of 60 minutes on a day to earn a chain badge from the GTA DVD Chest.
title: GTA 6 Twitch Drops Are Coming Soon, Here’s How To Get Your Free Rewards

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Xbox has revealed more details about its next-gen device, Project Helix, describing it as a "console capable of playing games from your PC."

title: Xbox Project Helix Is A Console That Plays PC Games, Not The Other Way Around
